Better together

Two I's become We.

One person is good. Two at the same table is better. That is the whole idea behind the double i.

A day at Happii Bellii

From first tea to last bite.

  1. Morning

    Tea and coffee

    Start at the bar with a cold brew or a jasmine milk tea.

  2. Lunch

    Bowls and noodles

    Big bowls out fast from the open kitchen.

  3. Afternoon

    Buns and sweets

    A bao, a fry basket and something sweet to share.

  4. Evening

    The long table

    Friends, neighbors and strangers become one crowd.

What we stand for

Five values, one table.

Spread Happiness

We believe happiness grows when shared. Every meal, smile and interaction is a chance to brighten someone's day.

Better Together

Two people coming together can create more joy and possibilities than one alone.

Everyone Belongs

Respect, dignity and the chance to thrive, whatever your abilities or background.

Care for Our Planet

Thoughtful choices about ingredients, resources and operations to reduce waste.

Good Food, Good Intentions

Flavorful, accessible food made with care, quality and integrity.

The space

Come sit at the long table.

Good to know

Quick answers.

Can I order online?

Order at the counter for now. An online ordering link will be added.

Is the space accessible?

Everyone belongs here. Tell the team what you need and we will make it work.

Do you do take away?

Yes. Dine in or take away, packed with a smile.

Can I bring a group?

The long shared tables fit a crowd. Come and sit together.

Why we exist

More than a full stomach.

A good meal can bring people together, share some joy and make everyone feel welcome.

We serve delicious, accessible Asian–European meals in a friendly space where everyone is respected, can contribute, and together we create something positive for our community.

Chúng tôi mang đến những bữa ăn Âu – Á ngon miệng, dễ tiếp cận trong một không gian thân thiện, nơi mọi người đều được tôn trọng và cùng nhau tạo nên những điều tích cực cho cộng đồng.

A full belly

Generous, flavorful food at prices that work for everyday.

A happy heart

Smiles at the door, at the counter and around the table.

A better world

Responsible sourcing, less waste, and jobs open to everyone.

The name

Every letter has a reason.

H & e

Happiness from beginning to end

Two letters styled as smiles, at the start and in the middle of the name.

ii

Two I's, Better Together

Two people, one table. Joy is bigger when it is shared.

Bellii

More than a full belly

A Full Belly. A Happy Heart. A Better World.

Everyone belongs

A team with a seat for everyone.

We are growing inclusive jobs step by step, especially for people with disabilities. Respect, dignity and the chance to thrive come standard.
